page.layout: One printed page, single column of verse, with running head at top; a marginal mark or note fragment at the left margin near the lines beginning "Qui fingunt" and "Aurato" and a catchword "Laxa" at the lower right.

main_text.l: Torrida seu longas aestas exporrigat horas,
Seu ver autumnusq; aequent cum lucibus umbras,
Signa dies condit sex, & totidem retegit nox,
Dimidiumque oculis pandit spectabile nostris.
Hunc quoque qua longo pracingit limite mundum
In partes veteres ter divisere quaternas,
Cuique suum nomen tribuentes, cuique figuram,
Cuique suos certis comprensos finibus ignes,
Qui fingunt varus animantum corpora formis.
Primus ad auroram circum cava tempora flexa
Cornua contorquens Aries, coelestia pandit
Lumina signorum, duclorque & ianitor anni
Aurato insignis villo de nocte serena,
Ter sex exiguis variatus corpora stellis.
Has, ubi fraternis exurgit Delia flammis
Aemula, seu domina cedens veniente recondit,
Destituens visus, & ni vicinia claris
Luceret stellis, etiam loci ipse lateret.
Hunc (quia vel Phryxum anevit Phryxique fororeā,
Cum fugerent seua furias fraudemque nouerca:
Vel quia per calidas Lybia squalentis arenas
Bacchus ab Eois agmen cum duceret oris,
Iamque siti nimia nimio sub sole labantes
Deficerent artus, feffis oftenderet undas)
Iuppiter in coeli media regione locauit,
Qua secat aquatrix obliquam linea Zonam.
Quaque hyemes placido gelidas a vere Colurus
Separat, in partes hanc atque hanc diuidit aquas.
Proxima Sidonij fulgent illustria Tauri
Sidera: quinque Hyades per fronte & cornua sparse,
Fata gemunt fratris, fraternaq; fata gementes
Irrorant tepidis fitientes nubibus agros.
Laxa

page.notes: Marginal marks at left (small reference marks beside "Qui fingunt" and "Aurato") and a small mark at the left near "Hunc quoque" are not legible as notes; the catchword "Laxa" is taken as the foot word. Some letters in the verse are doubtful (e.g. "anevit", "fororeā", "squalentis") and should be checked against the scan.
